{{Quote|Let me get this straight: you showed up, expecting to fight the little droid. But a huge droid showed up instead?|Mendi Dian, to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''3V-2L''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-empowered [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] created by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Umbral]] from the chassis of an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] as part of his [[Master's Top Secret Army]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. The droid was defeated by the [[Alliance Commander]] at some point on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR" />
